# GeoWeather

> Weather forecasts and climate data for every location on Earth.

## What it is

GeoWeather is Weather forecasts and climate data for every location on Earth.

## Platforms

- Web
- iOS
- Android

## Plans

- Free (USD 0): Current conditions and 3-day forecast.
- Pro (USD 6): 7-day forecast, radar, and alerts.
- Enterprise (USD 49): API access and custom integrations.

## Free tools

- [7-day forecast](https://geoweather.example.com/tools/7-day-forecast): Get a seven-day weather forecast for any city.
- [Radar map](https://geoweather.example.com/tools/radar-map): Interactive precipitation radar for your region.
- [Climate comparison](https://geoweather.example.com/tools/climate-comparison): Compare average temperatures and rainfall across cities.

## Common questions

Q: Is the weather data real-time?
A: Yes. Data refreshes every 15 minutes from national weather services.

Q: Which locations are supported?
A: Every populated place on Earth — over 3 million locations.

Q: Do you offer an API?
A: Yes, on the Enterprise plan. See the pricing page for details.
